text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The holiday season is at its peak.
Although the
mood throughout campus
is festive, Air Shakur
seems unaffected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is just around the
corner, so
she's putting the final touches
on Parcae's model.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even with Air Shakur's fate overturned,
Parcae
continues to be an important
partner to her. I'll
confirm the confirm
the details with her later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I probably still haven't been able to
become the
idea partner for Air Shakur,
but I've never given
up trying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as it's a special occasion, I pick
up a small
gift for her in hopes of
conveying the feelings I
usually can't.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's mostly sorted.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I think all that's left is for me give you
my report.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, but let's get started. We don't
have time
to waste.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, Manhattan Cafe is the one to
watch
out for.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I can't let the race develop favorably for
her. I'll
pull away on the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're obviously a threat, but not as
much as
before.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's gotta pass the torch at some
point.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's what they say. Actually, I
thought it
was going to skip a
generation...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I never planned to compete in the Arima
Kinen
this year.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I ran it once before... and lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That was... Well, I thought that was
game over for
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And after that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But now, I come out on top in every
simulation no
matter what conditions I
set.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I was just thinking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why was Parcae trying to lead me down
such a
hard road?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why was it trying to lay that fate on me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her question is sincere, but there's no
clear
answer. Though, one thing comes
to my mind...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I've heard as much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't they also say that they always
provide a
way out or something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Real funny. So what, the gods overrated
me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What a joke. If that's divine favor, they
can keep
it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them what I'm made of on the
greatest
and most terrible stage.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll laugh in their stupid faces and brush
them
aside. As many times as I need to.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aren't you going take your shot?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You went out earlier, right? Considering
what day
it is, I figure you were
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Or can I leave?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that she's seen right through
me.
However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're so lame.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is, huh? Makes no sense
at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure how to respond, but Air
Shakur is
laughing so I decide to just let
it slide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur lets out a big laugh. Knowing
how she
is now, I know her laughter is
genuine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. Parcae's just a program.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What about me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What the hell are you babbling about?
Of course
not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Parcae and Air Shakur are bound by
some sort of
special connection. At
least, it feels that way to
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I still don't think Parcae was
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We're just different. It's... hard to
explain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I really was fated to lose by seven
centimeters
and then fail in my senior
year, there was no way I
was going to
just sit back and accept it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: But, if this is the result of sticking to your guns... If I can review the equation and be confident there were no mistakes, then that is the solution.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, if I were able to tell Parcae
something, it
would be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right now, there's not a single person
who doesn't
know my name. And not
only that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: They'll never forget it either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And I'll prove it at the Arima Kinen.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our peaceful evening draws to a
close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After much deliberation, I opted to get
her
something she could use, so I picked
out a few
cans of her favorite coffee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I go to put the coffee
away, only
to find a single piece of
candy left in their place.
